name: Pacifiers and sucking/teething aids
governing_basis: EN 1400 soother standard, which requires the EN 71-3 / Directive 2009/48/EC Annex II Part III Category III element-migration limits. Pacifiers are excluded from the Toy Safety Directive itself (Annex I item 16), so the migration limits are read across from the toy-migration regime via the EN 1400 route; the limit values are identical
native_basis_label: element migration from soother material (EN 1400 / EN 71-3 Category III, mg/kg)
scope_note: Covers soothers/pacifiers and sucking/teething aids (the nipple, shield, ring, and any clip in the mouthing zone). Teething toys with play value are certified under Teething toys/teethers; pacifier metal safety is governed via the EN 1400 soother standard.

Pb.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
Pb.label: EN 1400 soother standard requires the EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III lead migration limit (23 mg/kg); pacifiers are excluded from the Toy Safety Directive itself (Annex I item 16) but the soother standard requires this limit

tAs.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
tAs.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III total-arsenic migration limit (47 mg/kg), applied via EN 1400. ASTM F963's nominal 25 mg/kg is lower on paper but incorporates an analytical-correction convention EN 71-3 abolished, so the EU raw limit is the stricter ceiling as enforced

iAs.rationale: Contact-product arsenic limits regulate the total arsenic element; no toy-safety or soother instrument sets an inorganic-arsenic limit. Inorganic arsenic is a dietary speciation with no migration counterpart. The tAs migration ceiling bounds the inorganic fraction.
iAs.reference_method: Total-arsenic migration screen (EN 71-3 / ICP-MS); no reflex iAs speciation defined for mouthable articles.

Cd.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
Cd.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III cadmium migration limit (17 mg/kg), applied via EN 1400

tHg.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
tHg.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III total-mercury migration limit (94 mg/kg), applied via EN 1400. ASTM F963's nominal 60 mg/kg incorporates an analytical-correction convention EN 71-3 abolished, so the EU raw limit is the stricter ceiling as enforced

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury is a marine-bioaccumulation speciation with no formation or migration pathway in a pacifier or teether. Every contact-product mercury limit is on total mercury. The tHg migration ceiling bounds any organomercury fraction.
MeHg.reference_method: Total-mercury migration screen (EN 71-3 / CV-AAS or ICP-MS).

Ni.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
Ni.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III nickel migration limit (930 mg/kg), applied via EN 1400

Al.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
Al.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III aluminium migration limit (28130 mg/kg), applied via EN 1400

Cr-VI.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
Cr-VI.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III hexavalent-chromium migration limit (0.053 mg/kg), applied via EN 1400

Cr-total.rationale: The governing soother/toy-migration instrument (EN 71-3 / Directive 2009/48/EC Annex II Part III Category III, applied via the EN 1400 soother standard) regulates hexavalent chromium specifically (Cr-VI, 0.053 mg/kg migration), not total chromium. The only sovereign total-chromium toy limits (ASTM F963, Mexico NOM-252, China GB 21027 soluble total-Cr, all ~60 mg/kg) are far more permissive than the Cr-VI migration ceiling and would understate control if published as the total-Cr standard. Total chromium is therefore screened, not assigned a published limit; any detectable total chromium reflexes to Cr-VI speciation, which binds at the Category III migration limit.
Cr-total.reference_method: Mandatory ICP-MS total-chromium migration screen (EN 71-3); reflex Cr-VI speciation (EN 71-3 / IEC 62321-7 or equivalent) on any detectable total chromium.

Sn.basis: element migration from scraped-off toy material (Category III); source unit mg/kg
Sn.label: EN 71-3 / 2009/48 Cat III tin migration limit (180000 mg/kg — very permissive; Tier-2 screen), applied via EN 1400

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, contact-product basis; no cross-basis min)
